# ROF-Carpet-Addition v1.6.1

# ROF-Carpet-Addition v1.6.0

## ✨ 新内容：

### 规则：

- ``爆炸合并 (mergeExplosion)`` : 把合并TNT产生的多次爆炸合成一次，对实体的作用会叠加 [`077db46`](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/077db4618ba8fab87de17fd93163dbb7a7413be5) [`6737dcd`](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/6737dcd06ef3b8a19eab2419ea7ccf3512c36eb5)
- ``刷怪统计化简白名单 (spawnStatisticSimplifyWhitelist)``:  按维度白名单跳过刷怪统计中的区块查找与生物群系查询，默认为 `{}` [`9ef2dcc`](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/9ef2dcc746d70c6a3b7ea74b8f872df78e40168b)
  - 注意：只有世界内没有任何生物群系定义刷怪势能时，化简结果才与原版完全一致。原版只有地狱有生物群系定义刷怪势能
- ``更好的珍珠加载票 (betterEnderPearlTicket)``:  在特定情况下用特殊加载票替代原有加载票；ECM 未开启时只对世界高度外的珍珠生效 [`949ab0a`](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/949ab0a902224477035e761f93dc4e64df8f16b6)
- ``珍珠加载堵塞主线程 (blockingEnderPearlLoading)``: 让珍珠的区块加载堵塞主线程，减少珍珠 tick 与世界 tick 不同步的问题；取值为最大堵塞时间（毫秒），`0` 表示禁用 [`949ab0a`](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/949ab0a902224477035e761f93dc4e64df8f16b6)

### 优化：

- 爆炸优化重构: 新增实体暴露度缓存 [`52a2fd4`](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/52a2fd44911b71502154f5a49e3fb34f8c21b48e)
- 合并TNTnext 优化: 新增 SafePlus 模式,比 Safe 更安全的合并模式 [`6737dcd`](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/6737dcd06ef3b8a19eab2419ea7ccf3512c36eb5)
## 🔧 更改：

- 统一规则命名：`optimizeRaycast` → `optimizedRaycast`、`optimizeItemMerge` → `optimizedItemMerge` [`6737dcd`](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/6737dcd06ef3b8a19eab2419ea7ccf3512c36eb5)
- 珍珠规则调整：`optimizeForcedEnderPearlTick`（String，含 `1_21_2-` / `1_21_2+` 选项）→ `optimizedEnderPearlTick`（boolean）；`enderPearlForcedSync`（boolean）→ `blockingEnderPearlLoading`（int，毫秒，`0` 为禁用） [`949ab0a`](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/949ab0a902224477035e761f93dc4e64df8f16b6)
- 语言文件整理：移除冗余的 `carpet.rule.*.name` 条目.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 本次统一了多条规则的命名与取值格式，旧配置文件中的键名会失效，需要手动更新：`optimizeRaycast` → `optimizedRaycast`、`optimizeItemMerge` → `optimizedItemMerge`、`optimizeForcedEnderPearlTick` → `optimizedEnderPearlTick`、`enderPearlForcedSync` → `blockingEnderPearlLoading`；规则 `mergeTNTOnlyNether` 已移除；列表类规则的取值需改为花括号包裹（如 `{!minecraft:drowned}`）。

有关各项规则的详细说明，请参阅[中文规则文档](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/blob/MCP/docs/zh_cn/rules.md)。

**完整更新日志：** [1.5.6...1.6.0](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/compare/1.5.6...1.6.0)

# ROF-Carpet-Addition v1.6.0

## ✨ New Features:

### Rules:

- ``mergeExplosion`` : Merges the multiple explosions produced by merged TNT into a single one; the effects on entities stack [`077db46`](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/077db4618ba8fab87de17fd93163dbb7a7413be5) [`6737dcd`](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/6737dcd06ef3b8a19eab2419ea7ccf3512c36eb5)
- ``spawnStatisticSimplifyWhitelist`` : Skips the chunk lookup and the biome query inside the spawn statistic for whitelisted dimensions; defaults to `{}` (no dimension simplified) [`9ef2dcc`](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/9ef2dcc746d70c6a3b7ea74b8f872df78e40168b)
  - Note: the result stays identical to vanilla only when no biome of the world defines spawn costs
- ``betterEnderPearlTicket`` : Replaces the vanilla loading ticket with a special loading ticket in certain cases; when ECM is not enabled, it only applies to pearls outside world height [`949ab0a`](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/949ab0a902224477035e761f93dc4e64df8f16b6)
- ``blockingEnderPearlLoading`` : Makes a pearl's chunk loading block the main thread, reducing desync between pearl ticks and world ticks; the value is the maximum blocking time in milliseconds, `0` disables it [`949ab0a`](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/949ab0a902224477035e761f93dc4e64df8f16b6)

# ROF-Carpet-Addition v1.5.6

## ✨ 新内容

### 版本支持

- 新增 Minecraft **1.21.5** 支持 [96c709a](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/96c709af7e4adeaf560ce0596d3d93b5993e1581)
- 新增 Minecraft **1.21.6 / 1.21.7 / 1.21.8** 支持 [4f879e5](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/4f879e57f16d7eca86862fa6b2dcd24cb755e27d)
- 新增 Minecraft **1.21.9 / 1.21.10** 支持 [50f61d9](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/50f61d90fb0ba1f7c004d2aad5af0456211a7a38) [3393f59](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/3393f59ecaa23937f30f934623ce43c667a2cd36)
- 新增 Minecraft **1.21.11** 支持 [b9c5bf7](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/b9c5bf7e237a7f171cd622c17da12fec848871ea) [f3539ec](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/f3539ecb8c4bce6b93b68a062a00c38e611980b5)

至此本模组同时支持 **Minecraft 1.21.5 ~ 1.21.11** 与 **26.1 / 26.2**。

## 🔧 更改

- 重命名三条规则：`mobAiStallChance` → `mobAIDelayChance`、`mobAiStallWhitelist` → `mobAIDelayWhitelist`、`mobAiStallTicks` → `mobAIDelayTicks`（规则名与描述中的「堵塞」改为「延迟」）[a67fb5a](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/a67fb5aa2d3635903330bbdcfb1c2dc74ea5a65d)

> `mobAiStall*` 三条规则的名称已变更，旧配置文件中的键名需要手动更新为 `mobAIDelay*`。

有关各项规则的详细说明，请参阅[中文规则文档](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/blob/MCP/docs/zh_cn/rules.md)。

# ROF-Carpet-Addition v1.5.6

## ✨ New Features

### Version Support

- Added support for Minecraft **1.21.5** [96c709a](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/96c709af7e4adeaf560ce0596d3d93b5993e1581)
- Added support for Minecraft **1.21.6 / 1.21.7 / 1.21.8** [4f879e5](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/4f879e57f16d7eca86862fa6b2dcd24cb755e27d)
- Added support for Minecraft **1.21.9 / 1.21.10** [50f61d9](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/50f61d90fb0ba1f7c004d2aad5af0456211a7a38) [3393f59](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/3393f59ecaa23937f30f934623ce43c667a2cd36)
- Added support for Minecraft **1.21.11** [b9c5bf7](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/b9c5bf7e237a7f171cd622c17da12fec848871ea) [f3539ec](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/f3539ecb8c4bce6b93b68a062a00c38e611980b5)

The mod now supports **Minecraft 1.21.5 ~ 1.21.11** alongside **26.1 / 26.2**.

## 🔧 Changes

- Renamed three rules: `mobAiStallChance` → `mobAIDelayChance`, `mobAiStallWhitelist` → `mobAIDelayWhitelist`, `mobAiStallTicks` → `mobAIDelayTicks` [a67fb5a](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/a67fb5aa2d3635903330bbdcfb1c2dc74ea5a65d)
- Aligned the English descriptions with the Chinese annotations and removed the extra entries [45be0a8](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/45be0a88836841d6f761e87d1339a08b60458ef3)

## 🐛 Fixes

- Fixed the swapped NBT read/write direction for the merged-TNT counter and the piglin stacking AI suppression state on 1.21.5 and older branches [96c709a](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/96c709af7e4adeaf560ce0596d3d93b5993e1581)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The `mobAiStall*` rules have been renamed; update the keys in existing config files to `mobAIDelay*`.

For detailed descriptions of each rule, see the [English rules documentation](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/blob/MCP/docs/en_us/rules.md).

**Full Changelog:** [1.5.5...1.5.6](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/compare/1.5.5...1.5.6)

# ROF-Carpet-Addition v1.5.0

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 从 v1.5.0 开始，本模组将仅继续支持 Minecraft 26 及更高版本。旧版本仅会获得必要的错误修复。

## ✨ 新内容

### 规则

- 随机刻区块延迟缓存 (`randomTickChunkCache`) [eb6f06b](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/eb6f06b)
- 生物生成区块延迟缓存 (`spawningChunkCache`) [eb6f06b](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/eb6f06b)
- 异步预计算随机刻 (`asyncRandomTick`) [eb6f06b](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/eb6f06b)
- 异步预计算自然生成 (`asyncNaturalSpawning`) [eb6f06b](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/eb6f06b)
- 更好的 NoAI NBT (`betterNoAiNbt`) [a2b45d9](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/a2b45d9)
- 生物 AI 堵塞概率 (`mobAiStallChance`) [12f7329](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/12f7329)
- 生物 AI 堵塞白名单 (`mobAiStallWhitelist`) [12f7329](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/12f7329)
- 生物 AI 堵塞时间 (`mobAiStallTicks`) [12f7329](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/12f7329)
- 实体推挤收集优化 (`optimizedEntityCollection`) [e63dc53](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/e63dc53)
- 可攀爬方块标签判断缓存 (`optimizedClimbableTagCheck`) [065fc82](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/065fc82)
- 假人 Tick 精简 (`optimizedFakePlayerTick`) [957153c](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/957153c)
- 珍珠加载强行同步 (`enderPearlForcedSync`) [33ee0a9](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/33ee0a9)

有关各项规则的详细说明，请参阅[中文规则文档](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/blob/MCP/docs/zh_cn/rules.md)。

# ROF-Carpet-Addition v1.5.0

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Starting with v1.5.0, this mod will only continue to support Minecraft 26 and later versions. Older versions will only receive essential bug fixes.

## ✨ New Features

### Rules

- Random tick chunk cache (`randomTickChunkCache`) [eb6f06b](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/eb6f06b)
- Natural spawning chunk cache (`spawningChunkCache`) [eb6f06b](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/eb6f06b)
- Asynchronous random tick precomputation (`asyncRandomTick`) [eb6f06b](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/eb6f06b)

- Mob AI stall whitelist (`mobAiStallWhitelist`) [12f7329](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/12f7329)
- Mob AI stall duration (`mobAiStallTicks`) [12f7329](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/12f7329)
- Entity push collection optimization (`optimizedEntityCollection`) [e63dc53](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/e63dc53)
- Climbable block tag check cache (`optimizedClimbableTagCheck`) [065fc82](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/065fc82)
- Fake player tick optimization (`optimizedFakePlayerTick`) [957153c](https://github.com/Melationin/ROF-Carpet-Addition/commit/957153c)
